gbm_population_evidence.quote: Family caregivers (≥18 years) to patients (≥18 years) diagnosed with a GBM grade IV or diffuse astrocytoma grade IV offered Stupps treatment regime.

candidate_evidence.quote: A 12-week supportive group intervention targeted caregivers to patients with glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: diagnosed with a GBM grade IV or diffuse astrocytoma grade IV offered Stupps treatment regime.

coder_notes: Behavioural supportive-care intervention for family caregivers (phase NA); enrolled participants are caregivers of patients with GBM grade IV / diffuse astrocytoma grade IV (historical terminology). gbm_population coded gbm_only for the disease context, but participants are not patients - adjudicator may prefer not_glioblastoma; screening outcome unaffected (no drug intervention, phase NA). Stupp regimen is the patients' background care, not delivered by the trial, so no agents listed.
